description: The outputs.json metadata document. It describes the raw model outputs that one run stored in the artifact.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema that the document satisfies.

kind.description: Kind of run. Listing tools use it as a hint. Readers dispatch on the model_type of each model.

producer.description: The package that wrote the document.

created_at.description: Absolute instant. Requires a trailing Z or a UTC offset.

systems.description: Maps the UUID of each source system to its directory, relative to the artifact.

simulation.description: Parameters of the simulation. Required when kind is simulation, and not allowed for other kinds.

models.description: The models that wrote data. Model names are unique in the document.

ProducerInfo.description: Provenance of the document. The writing package records it at write time.

julia.description: Julia version that ran the writer.

SimulationParams.description: Parameters of the whole simulation run. They do not belong to one model.

initial_time.description: Start of the simulation. Naive local datetime with no zone or offset.

execution_order.description: Names of the models in the order that the simulation runs them.
